Vertical 9:16 cinematic feature-anime KEY ART, richly painted pastel-watercolor environments with fine ink edges and tactile paper grain. Sophisticated adult Tamil university romance, premium theatrical composition. Warm apricot sunlight against deep dusty-blue and teal shadows, terracotta, dark walnut, ivory, subtle rose accents. Strong volumetric light, deep layered perspective, near foreground softness, crisp main subject and distant atmospheric depth. Not photoreal, not a flat childrens illustration. No phones, ribbons, wedding decor, nursery furniture, school posters, balloons, watermarks or extra readable text.

Cinematic WIDE low-angle establishing shot from eight metres in front of the monumental university portal, camera at one metre height, 24mm lens perspective without fisheye. An imposing SOUTH INDIAN UNIVERSITY main academic block, spacious terracotta-and-cream facade with tall vertical window bays and a deep shaded colonnade. ONE pair of SIX-METRE-TALL dark teal timber doors in a monumental rectangular cream-stone portal, two long vertical recessed panels per leaf, long dark-bronze handles; broad grey granite entrance steps. Heavy adult-scale architecture. Behind these doors is a vast university LECTURE THEATRE, nine-metre-high ceiling with exposed dark timber beams, double-height windows on LEFT, long curved rows of adult-sized walnut lecture seats rising on shallow tiers to either side of a clear central aisle, a wide slate-green presentation wall at the far end and one full-sized lectern off to the right. No extra doorway inside. Closed doors fully conceal the interior. Show the full six-metre portal and adjacent double-height window bays so it reads as a grand UNIVERSITY building, not a small classroom or cottage. Strong diagonal late-afternoon sunbeam from upper LEFT, deep blue shade inside the porch; foreground props create a pronounced near/middle/far composition. Doorway centred, clear straight route up the broad steps. VISIBLE LEVITATING FOREGROUND OBJECTS, essential to the composition: a single open cream notebook hovers 60 centimetres in front of the lens at LOWER LEFT, tilted toward camera, partly cropped and occupying about 20 percent of frame width; its pages are blank. A closed burgundy hardback with blank cover hovers at MID-RIGHT, nearer than the architecture, tilted diagonally and occupying about 15 percent of frame width. Two separate cream paper sheets curl through the near foreground at different depths. One slim wooden pencil floats horizontally near the notebook. Objects cast soft self-shadows, are clearly suspended without strings or supports, and do not cover the central doorway or title. Only these five objects, no confetti cloud; restrained magical realism. No people or human intervention. No visible text anywhere, including covers, sheets and facade. Architectural scale and composition should feel like an animated film opening, not a property listing.
